facts.label: Problemas em casa
facts.sub: Conte o passado com o passado simples: The pipe broke. Fale do futuro com if/when + presente e will: If it breaks again, I’ll call him.

facts.label: Passado simples
facts.sub: Use o passado simples para contar o que aconteceu: The pipe broke. He fixed it. Water was on the floor. Muitos verbos são irregulares: break vira broke, buy vira bought.

facts.label: Se
facts.sub: Use if + presente simples, e depois will + verbo base: If it breaks again, I’ll call him. Depois de if, não use will. É a forma mais usada para planos e avisos.

pages.title: An old kitchen · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Wednesday morning in an old house in Ottawa. Sara stands in her kitchen in wet socks. There is a big towel on the floor. Her neighbor Hal knocks at the door. He sees the wet floor. He asks about the sink.
“Hi, Sara! What happened to your sink?” says Hal. “The pipe broke last night. Water was on the floor.” says Sara. “Oh no! What did you do?” says Hal.

answers: Yesterday I ___. → broke
She ___ every day. → fixes
He is ___ now. → calling
We ___ every day. → turn off
